0022600137.text: The New York Knicks (1-3) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-3) for their fifth game of the 2026-27 season. The Knicks, sitting 4th in the Atlantic and 12th in the East, are riding a one-game win streak but are 0-1 on the road, while the Bulls, 4th in the Central and 11th in the East, have lost their last two games. Knicks guard Jose Alvarado is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Bulls center Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and also game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-96 win in New York on April 3, 2026.
